component.name: Oxipod
component.summary: Put music on your old iPod

description.p: Oxipod adds music to iPods that sync through iTunes, without needing iTunes. Plug in your iPod, drop your music on the window, and it's ready to play.

ul.li: Add songs and whole folders by dragging them onto the window
Converts FLAC, Opus, Ogg, WAV and other formats to MP3 automatically
Copies cover art from the file or from a cover image in the album folder, or lets you pick one yourself
Search the songs and sort them by title, artist, album or date added
Finds songs that are on the iPod twice, so you can delete the extra copies
Create playlists, add or remove songs, and pick several songs on a playlist's page
Fix the title, artist, album and album artist of one song or of several at once
Delete songs from the iPod, one at a time or several at once
Copy songs back to your computer, in folders by artist and album if you like
Offers to back up the iPod's database before you open it, and puts a backup back if something goes wrong
Sets newer iPods up by itself the first time you open them
Finds and cleans up leftover files from interrupted syncs, and songs whose files are gone
Tells you when an iPod can't be changed, like one that was formatted on a Mac, and says why

description.p: Oxipod is built on libgpod, so it should work with the iPods libgpod supports, like the iPod classic, the mini and the nano up to the 4th generation. So far it has only been tested with the iPod nano 3rd generation. The touchscreen nano (6th and 7th generation), the iPod touch and iPhones are not supported.

screenshot.caption: The songs on an iPod nano

description.p: Edit tags, pick songs on playlists, and put a backup back.

ul.li: Edit the title, artist, album and album artist of a song, or of several songs at once. This changes what the iPod shows, not your files
Tick several songs on a playlist's page to take them off it or copy them in one go
Restore from Backup puts a backup back on the iPod. Oxipod checks that it is from this iPod and saves what is on the iPod now first, so you can undo it
Songs that are in the list but whose files are gone get a banner, with a button to take them out of the list
An iPod that is mounted read-only, like one formatted on a Mac, shows a lock and a banner that says why, and everything that would change it is switched off
New screenshots

The iPod classic and the nano from the 3rd generation on need a description of themselves before Oxipod can write to them. Oxipod now fetches it the first time you open the iPod, so you no longer need a command in a terminal
If that doesn't work, Oxipod shows the command to run by hand, with your drive filled in

description.p: Pick covers, find duplicates, and a backup before you start.

ul.li: Oxipod offers to back up the iPod's database when you open it
Choose a cover for a song, a whole album or the selected songs, and show the songs that have none
Find songs that are on the iPod twice and delete the extra copies in one go
Copy songs back in folders by artist and album, or copy everything on the iPod at once
Rename the iPod from the list of iPods
An About window with a Report an Issue button and troubleshooting details

description.p: You can now copy songs from the iPod back to your computer.

ul.li: Copy to Computer in the menu of a song, or for a whole selection, with names like "Artist - Title.mp3"
Nothing gets overwritten, and songs that are already in the folder are skipped
The list of iPods no longer shows where the iPod is mounted
A softer placeholder for songs without cover art

description.p: The song list is a lot faster with big libraries, and you can now search and sort it.

ul.li: Search your songs (Ctrl+F)
Sort by title, artist, album or when you added them
Select All only ticks the songs the search shows
No more GLib warnings when ejecting

description.p: Select several songs at once to delete them or add them to a playlist.
